description: This file is a shell script designed for testing binary diff and apply operations within a Git repository. It includes test cases for binary diffing, applying patches, handling corrupt patches, and dealing with binary files in various scenarios, using Git commands and custom test functions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, runs provided commands, and verifies outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands and expects them to fail, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_might_fail
methods.description: Runs commands that may fail without causing the overall test to fail, used for non-critical checks.
